preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 200000 for N in test_case_Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size N is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(-1 <= x < N for x in A) for A in test_case_As)
preconditions.description: For each test case, every element in array A is either -1 or an integer between 0 and N-1 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N for N, A in zip(test_case_Ns, test_case_As))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array A has exactly N elements.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1' or (len(line.split()) == N and all(1 <= int(x) <= N for x in line.split()) and len(set(line.split())) == N)) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' or a space-separated sequence of N distinct integers from 1 to N (a valid permutation).

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1' or (is_valid_permutation_for_A(line.split(), A))) for line, A in zip(stdout_lines, test_case_As))
postconditions.description: If a permutation is output, it must be valid for the given array A according to the generation rules; otherwise '-1' is output.

postconditions.expression: all((line == '-1' or (is_lexicographically_smallest_valid_permutation(line.split(), A))) for line, A in zip(stdout_lines, test_case_As))
postconditions.description: If a valid permutation exists for a test case, the output must be the lexicographically smallest among all valid permutations; otherwise '-1' is output.
